children: US biopharma company's Q3 revenue fell sharply yr/yr, mainly due to lower Gilead collaboration revenue
Q3 net loss narrowed from prior year as R&D and admin costs declined
Company ended Q3 with $694 mln cash, plus $288 mln raised in October equity offering
Company expects full-year 2026 GAAP revenue of $70 mln to $75 mln
Arcus expects near-term R&D expenses to remain relatively consistent
Company expects cash runway to fund operations into 2029
GILEAD COLLABORATION WIND-DOWN - Co said lower Q3 revenue was mainly due to winding down of Gilead collaboration activities
R&D SPENDING SHIFT - Lower R&D expenses driven by wind-down of domvanalimab studies and PRISM-1 enrollment, partly offset by increased investment in casdatifan programs
COST STREAMLINING - Co said lower admin expenses reflected streamlining initiatives across operations
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 13 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the biotechnology & medical research peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Arcus Biosciences, Inc. is $42.00, about 122.1% above its November 3 closing price of $18.91
